nav.title: Malo Ogwiritsira Ntchito AI
nav.subtitle: Utumiki wokha wamiyalunda yambiri ndi kusintha koyendetsedwa kwa anthu.

customer.title: Yamba kuganizirana
customer.consentText: Ndiloleranji kuti kuganizirana kumeneku kufufuzidwe ndi wopereka wa AI woyandikidwa. Mankhwala azimitse usanayike.
customer.setupHint: Simupeza mpaka woyang'anira akhazikitse kiyi yosindikiza ndi wopereka wa AI.
customer.chatEmpty: Mauthenga anu adzaoneka pano. Zochita za AI ndi zilangizo zokha; palibe malipiro, kusintha kwa akaunti, kubweza kapena kutumira kumachitika.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Mawu a msakatuli amatumizidwa mwa kuyenda kwa wopereka wokonzedwa; OpsCore sinena kuti imasunga mawu osakonzedwa.
customer.voiceRequirement: Mawu a msakatuli amafuna HTTPS (kapena localhost), maikolofoni, chilolezo, chitsanzo cha Realtime chokonzedwa ndi kiyi ya wopereka. Si mlatho wa foni wa PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Mkhalapakati woyanditsa
queue.description: Kuganizirana koopsa, kosatha kapena kofuna munthu kumaoneka pano. Chinachake mkhalapakati kutanthauza kopempha, osakhala kogwiritsidwa.
queue.empty: Palibe kusintha kwa anthu kwa bungwe ili.
queue.replyStorageNote: Mayankho a anthu amasungidwa obisika ndipo amawoneka mu zolemba za kukambirana.
queue.resolveNote: Kwathetsedwa ndi wogwiritsa ntchito wamunthu wosankhidwa.

boundaries.title: Malelekedwe a ntchito
boundaries.automateBody: Yankho loyamba lamiyalunda yambiri, kufotokoza, kusindikiza chidule ndi chiopsezo, kusunga mankhwala motetezeka, kupanga makhalapakati ndi kupatsa anthu ntchito.
boundaries.humanBody: Pempho la munthu lolemetsa, chikhulupiriro chochepa, chiopsezo chaukali, malamulo osowa, nkhani yosathetsedwa, kulira za chinsinsi/chitetezo kapena zochita zosadziwika.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Kutsata PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imeyilo, bridge ya foni yamoyo, kutsimikizira kwa anthu CRM ndi zolengedwa za ubwino wa miyalunda zimasowa adapta wa wopereka, zizindikiritso ndi mayeso ovomereza.

messages.qualificationNotice: Palibe chiyankhulo chovomerezeka pamene mayeso a malemba, ASR, TTS, mawu ache ndi kukweza sanathe.
messages.configOk: Kukonza kuli. Kulondola kwa wopereka ndi ubwino wa miyalunda kufunika mayeso ovomereza owona.
messages.conversationCreated: Kuganizirana kotetezedwa kunapangidwa. Ubwino wa miyalunda sunavomerezedwe.
messages.handoffQueued: Kusintha kwa munthu kwatchidwa mkhalapakati ({reason}). Iyi ndi pempho la mkhalapakati, osati kugwirizana koyenda.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Yankho la AI linatha. Palibe chinachake chidachitika. Mutha kupempha wothandizira wamunthu.
messages.apiUnavailable: API ya Contact Center sinathe kutsegulidwa. Lowani mu kontholo ya OpsCore, kenako tsegulaninso tsambali.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Kusamutsira kwa munthu kwayikidwa pamzere ({reason}). Mzere sutsimikizira kuti wothandizira walumikizidwa.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Kusamutsira kwa munthu kwayikidwa pamzere. Gawo la AI la msakatuli likuyima; kusamutsa foni mwachindunji sikunakonzedwe.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Akupempha satifiketi ya mawu ya nthawi yochepa…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Wopereka wa nthawi yeniyeni wanena cholakwika. Imitsani gawo la mawu ndipo yeserani kachiwiri mutayang'ana kasinthidwe ka wopereka.
messages.voiceActive: Gawo la mawu likugwira ntchito. Dinani “Pemphani wothandizira wamunthu” nthawi iliyonse; izi zimapanga chinthu pamzere, osati kusamutsa kwa PSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Wopereka mawu a nthawi yeniyeni sanapezeke.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Msakatuli uyu sagwirizira mawu a nthawi yeniyeni.
